value.name: decides not to sell house
value.description: He resolves not to sell the house his mother had wanted him to keep.
evidence: nd decided not to sell the house his mother had wanted him not to sell.

value.name: reflects on boundaries and attachments
value.description: She considers the difference between holding boundaries and holding attachments, realizing the distinction is a hinge rather than a wall.
evidence: She thought about her own boundaries, which she had held, and about her own attachments, which she had not yet decided what to do with, and about the difference between the two, which she understood now to be not a wall but a hinge.

value.name: returns home and settles in
value.description: She comes home, puts the food in the kitchen, and sits in the front room watching the afternoon light move across the floor.
evidence: She came home and put the food in the kitchen and sat in the front room and watched the afternoon light move across the floor

value.name: feels affirmed in her work
value.description: She thinks, for the first time in weeks, that she is still doing the work she is meant to do.
evidence: she thought, for the first time in some weeks, that she was, in spite of everything, doing the work she was meant to do.

value.name: visits mother on Sunday
value.description: On Sunday she drives to her mother's house for her monthly visit and sits with her on the porch.
evidence: On Sunday she drove out to her mother's, which she did once a month, and she sat with her mother on the porch

value.name: listens patiently to mother
value.description: She listens without impatience as her mother talks about neighbors and vegetable prices.
evidence: and listened to her mother tell her about the neighbor's dog and the neighbor's grandson and the price of vegetables, and she did not, this time, find herself impatient.

value.name: considers mother's mortality
value.description: While her mother talks, she thinks about her mother's eventual death and realizes the Serrano estate has made that thought slightly easier to begin.
evidence: She thought, while her mother talked, that her mother also lived in a house, and that someday her mother also would not, and that she had so far not been able to bring herself to think about that day, and that the Serrano estate had made it, very slightly, possible to begin.

value.name: drives home at night
value.description: She leaves her mother's house and drives home in the dark.
evidence: She drove home in the dark.

value.name: sleeps poorly and wakes early
value.description: She sleeps badly, wakes at four, and lies awake staring at the ceiling.
evidence: She slept, badly again, and woke at four, and lay looking at the ceiling

value.name: reviews Monday agenda
value.description: At five she gets up, makes coffee, and reviews the Monday agenda twice without changing it.
evidence: and at five she got up and made coffee and sat at the kitchen table with the agenda for Monday in front of her and read it through once and then again, and she crossed out nothing and added nothing
